column1: ## Repository Table R24. DeepSEA adaptation settings and run history

## Description: Recorded input and mapping properties for each S21 run. The Run selection column identifies the runs used in the current comparison and earlier runs retained for context. Active hEVO-large-o run 24 and GPN-Star-M differ in training duration, pooling or native input handling from some comparators.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Model | Evaluated checkpoint display name, harmonized with the figures.
## Column 2 | Category | Category for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Run | Run for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | Run selection | Identifies whether the recorded run is current or prior to the comparison.
## Column 5 | Configured input length | Configured input length for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 6 | Pooling | Pooling for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 7 | Seed | Random seed of the recorded projection or sampling run.
## Column 8 | Training input rows | Training input rows for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 9 | Training mapped rows | Training mapped rows for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 10 | Training mapping fraction | Training mapping fraction for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 11 | Test input rows | Test input rows for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 12 | Test mapped rows | Test mapped rows for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 13 | Test mapping fraction | Test mapping fraction for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 14 | AUROC | Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve; larger is better; chance expectation 0.5.
## Column 15 | Macro AUPRC | Macro AUPRC for the observation defined in the table description.
